stepNotes.1: The unit separates record schema/IDs, SQLite queries, semantic-call batching, JSONL projection, decoding, and narrative reports.
stepNotes.2: Sensitive args and session history cross durable/export boundaries; key risks are record loss, overexposure, call/result mismatch, and malformed policy context.
stepNotes.3: Composite cursors preserve global order, call IDs pair actions, and shutdown hooks drain queued rows during normal process teardown.
stepNotes.4: Multi-value inserts amortize writes and streamAll paginates, while per-session report/export query materialization is the long-session scaling limit.
stepNotes.5: Capture, persistence timing, machine export, and human report responsibilities remain cleanly separated over shared replay events.
stepNotes.6: No TODOs or empty catches were found; queue flush failure is logged and documented as a drop policy with synchronous mode available.
stepNotes.7: Semantic, SIEM, report, JSON, CLI, route, and LSP tests are broad; high-volume pagination/memory behavior is the notable gap.
stepNotes.8: No finding is registered or newly accepted because observed durability loss is an explicit, observable queue-mode tradeoff.
stepNotes.9: The audit/control-plane selection passed 104 tests and core typechecking passed.
